name: br_volcano_great
notes: One record -- the volcano_greatsmoke2 smoke-and-fire effect at roll 0, bias 0, standing on the crater floor -- WITH ITS MOUNTAIN (relief) and the paint on it (ground). Found by the author's WE_OBJECTS_V1 paste; three stand on the map and all three are saved. Constant across them: the effect sits at ground level in a crater 7-13 m under the highest rim; elemental_02_07 lava fills the crater (34-59% of r < 10 m, gone by 30 m) with valcano_04 veined rock round it (41-75% to 20-30 m, streaks to 50 m) and valcano_rock below; 100% blocked out to r 30-40 m. Declare elemental_02_07 and valcano_04 at weight 0.0. No facing: a cone may be turned freely, but the record stays roll 0. THIS ONE: the great massif at (1011, 546) -- the crater is NOT the summit: a peak 29 m higher stands 55 m to the south, and the whole is blocked to r 60. 240 m across; it wants a quarter of a sector to itself.
